episodes.synopsis: Makoto is preparing a science experiment for the school festival; when jealous rival Jinnai sabotages it, he inadvertently opens a portal to a strange and magnificent world.
episodes.title: Drawn in to the Land of Adventure

episodes.synopsis: Makoto and Mr. Fujisawa rescue a beautiful young woman from giant humanoid bugs; she introduces herself as Princess Rune Venus of Roshtaria.
episodes.title: Exploring the Kingdom of Mystery

episodes.synopsis: Makoto and Mr. Fujisawa look for a way home; meanwhile, Jinnai enchants the Bugrom's Queen with his idea to attack a village's water supply.
episodes.title: The Enchanting Princess

episodes.synopsis: Rune Venus tells Makoto about Great Priestesses whose ancient magic might be able to take him home.
episodes.title: The Lonely Priestess

episodes.synopsis: Afura Mann, the Priestess of Wind, has a massive library that may have answers for Makoto.
episodes.title: The Shrine of Wind

episodes.synopsis: Makoto and Mr. Fujisawa journey to meet the Priestess of Fire, Shayla.
episodes.title: A Game of Chance and Fire

episodes.synopsis: While others are seeking a way home, Nanami is working.
episodes.title: A Golden Opportunity

episodes.synopsis: Miz Mistal wishes for Mr. Fujisawa's love at a legendary fountain; when it malfunctions, she fears a catastrophe has occurred.
episodes.title: Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Nanami decides to open her own restaurant; when the kingdom's vegetables suddenly go missing, Makoto attempts to solve the mystery.
episodes.title: House of Thieves

episodes.synopsis: A village is being threatened by a monster who's is attacking its crops and livestock; seeking adventure, Mr. Fujisawa volunteers to go on a monster hunt.
episodes.title: The Jungle Beast

episodes.synopsis: Makoto and Mr. Fujisawa decide to help Rune Venus take care of some orphaned children.
episodes.title: A Child's Heart

episodes.synopsis: An oppressive heat wave covers the land.
episodes.title: Tomb of the Demon God

episodes.synopsis: The ultimate weapon has awoken, and she's under the control of Jinnai.
episodes.title: Pure Evil Genius

episodes.synopsis: One of the seven wonders of El-Hazard, the Legendary Snow falls only once every 100 years.
episodes.title: The Legendary Snowfields

episodes.synopsis: A flashback to Shayla's encounter with an apprentice priestess that changed her destiny.
episodes.title: Tale of the Priestess

episodes.synopsis: A gigantic whirlwind appears in the deserts of Roshtaria.
episodes.title: Whirlwind

episodes.synopsis: Rune Venus dreams of a golden room from her childhood, and wonders if it's the Chamber of Promises; Makoto goes with her to investigate.
episodes.title: The Eye of God

episodes.synopsis: Jinnai attempts to reverse his fortunes with a daring plan.
episodes.title: Operation: Abduction

episodes.synopsis: Makoto and Mr. Fujisawa are in hot pursuit of Jinnai in an attempt to rescue Rune Venus.
episodes.title: Hive of Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Jinnai's decision to kidnap Nanami along with Rune Venus backfires when she discovers she can speak to the Bugrom.
episodes.title: Jinnai: Sister vs. Brother

episodes.synopsis: The Great Saint River is a dangerous, forbidden sanctuary.
episodes.title: A Love in Peril

episodes.synopsis: Makoto will have to face the Bugrom, Ifurita, and Jinnai's greatest trump card: Rune Venus.
episodes.title: A Death-Defying Rescue

episodes.synopsis: While Afura Mann and the Bugrom are searching for the Princess, Nanami has already found her.
episodes.title: Escape

episodes.synopsis: Cataclysms rock the world and the Bugrom launch an all-out invasion; worst of all, the Eye of God is falling out of its orbit.
episodes.title: Destiny

episodes.synopsis: Jinnai's dreams of conquest are about to come to fruition, but when Ifurita's personality abruptly changes, he looses control of her.
episodes.title: The End of the World

episodes.synopsis: Makoto releases the reactor energy from the Eye of God.
episodes.title: The Eternal Dream
